title: Best Time to Visit Phuket 2026 — Rain, Crowds, Prices by Month | ThailandAddict
metaDesc: When should you visit Phuket? A month-by-month comparison of rain, waves, prices and crowds — plus the Andaman-coast rain pattern most first-timers miss.
ogDesc: Which months are clear, which are rough — check before you book
intro: Phuket works year-round, but the Andaman coast doesn't rain on the same schedule as the Gulf coast. Here's which months are clear and calm, and which to plan around, before you book.
quickAnswerHtml: Short answer: November to February is Phuket's best stretch — dry, clear, calm seas — but it's also high season with the highest prices. The rainy season (May-October) usually brings showers in bursts, not all-day rain, and prices drop a lot, though some west-coast beaches get red-flag warnings from rough surf.

blocks.html: Short answer: Phuket sits on the Andaman coast, which rains on a different schedule than the Gulf coast (Koh Samui, Koh Phangan). The best window is November to February — dry, clear skies, calm seas, great for diving and beach days — but it's high season with the highest prices. The rainy season, May to October, usually brings showers in bursts during the afternoon or evening rather than all-day rain, and accommodation gets much cheaper — though some west-coast beaches see rough surf strong enough for red-flag swimming bans.

The Andaman coast (Phuket, Krabi, Phi Phi) gets its heaviest rain May through October — the opposite of the Gulf coast (Koh Samui, Koh Phangan, Koh Tao), which sees its heaviest rain October through December. So if you're visiting during Phuket's rainy season and want guaranteed sun, Koh Samui might have better weather in some of those months, or vice versa. During the rainy season, red flags go up often on west-facing beaches like Patong, Kata and Karon — always check the beach flags before swimming.

items: Want clear skies and calm water — come November to February, but book accommodation early since high season fills up fast
On a budget, not fussed about rain — come May to September, when prices drop noticeably and rain usually only affects part of the day
Want to avoid rough seas — be cautious September-October on west-coast beaches, and always check beach flags before swimming

faq.q: Can you visit Phuket in the rainy season?
faq.a: Yes — rain usually comes in bursts, not all day, and prices drop a lot. Some west-coast beaches get red-flag warnings from rough surf though, so always check the beach flags before swimming.

faq.q: Do Phuket and Koh Samui have rain at the same time?
faq.a: No. Phuket is on the Andaman coast and gets its heaviest rain May-October, while Koh Samui is on the Gulf coast and gets its heaviest rain October-December. If one is rainy, the other may have better weather.

faq.q: When are Phuket hotel prices highest?
faq.a: November through February (high season), especially around Christmas and New Year, when rooms fill up fast and prices peak. Book several months ahead for that window.
